rows.definition: superloop_orphaned is the superloop walk-verdict finding token emitted when at least one member loop is ORPHANED: a tick emitted downstream follow-on work — a relay ArtifactIssue baton pointer or the issue an a2achan.WorkerStatus names — that nobody advanced or closed within its cadence window (#4957). It binds the closed relay reason RELAY_ORPHANED_FOLLOWON and demands chasing or redirecting the emitted output through the member's own front door, never an auto-refile.
rows.distinction: Not superloop_dark (the member stopped ticking — the liveness axis) and not superloop_spinning (the member ticks but its OWN ledger-verified progress high-water did not advance — the loop-grain progress axis): superloop_orphaned is the FLEET-grain follow-on axis — the loop DID advance at its own grain (it emitted work) but that emitted work is stalled downstream. Fail-closed like superloop_spinning: an unreadable or unresolvable emission (FollowonUnknown) never earns the token, so an orphan is never fabricated from an absence.

rows.definition: FleetDebt is the superloop fleet-walk ranking key (#4958): the liveness x progress x follow-on PRODUCT minus one, so a clean live member folds to debt 0 and the ordinary worst-first sort (tier, then debt descending) ranks the fleet with no rival walker. A product, not a sum, because the axes compound — a stale loop that is also spinning pays cadence cost for zero verified output on two grains at once, and outranks either fault alone.
rows.distinction: Not a single-axis finding token: superloop_dark, superloop_spinning, and superloop_orphaned each name WHICH axis is in debt, whereas FleetDebt is the SCALAR fold that compounds all three into one comparable magnitude the worst-first sort orders on. Distinct from superloop_debt (the aggregate measured member debt over a floor): FleetDebt is the per-member product-of-axes, and an unread axis multiplies by 1 so it never fabricates debt.
